proof_scope.Rains: Root-sheaf existence for each effective simple root; effective cone pointed; equal-numerical-class injections are isomorphisms; rank-zero Euler pairing. Primary Rains arXiv:1907.11301v1.
proof_scope.local_result: All other irreducible root classes excluded via negative pairing; total graded Ext algebra is Dynkin zigzag using Serre 2-CY pairing.
proof_scope.formality: Liu--Wang, J. Algebra 677 (2025), Theorem 1.1, arXiv:2301.06757v3: intrinsic formality ADE zigzag over characteristic zero. Isolated A1 factor is degree-formal.
proof_scope.deformation: Fixed enhanced Rains dg category, framed MC before gauge quotient has x_ij*x_ji=0 per Dynkin edge and no higher A-infinity terms.
proof_scope.not_verified: Rains relative surface moduli; entire anticanonical heart; actual 2d/1d A=R/(g-1) module matrices; mixed delta rank; all-q derived equivalence.

calculation_scope: Exact root enumeration, negative pairings, simple graph, leaf elimination; not a numerical proof of sheaf existence or intrinsic formality.
